offerDetails.desc: I provide high-quality restoration and wooden furniture maintenance with attention to detail, with over {{years}} years of experience in carpentry and interior decoration.
offerDetails.acceptedMsg: {{name}}'s offer has been accepted for this tender.

o1.desc: Our foundation seeks comprehensive restoration and renovation of the "Board Room" facilities, including maintaining, renewing and rehabilitating the existing wooden furniture to the highest quality standards, matching our corporate identity and ready for use in the best possible condition.

o2.desc: Our foundation needs new electrical installations in the administration building to approved safety standards, including modern distribution boards and energy-efficient lighting.

o3.desc: We are looking for a contractor to restore the school building, repair damaged roofs and walls, and rehabilitate classrooms so they are safe and ready for students.

o4.desc: Our foundation is tendering the construction of a complete medical complex including clinics, waiting rooms and service facilities, per the approved plans and specifications.

a1.name: Waseem Mohammad
a1.desc: Full commitment to all occupational safety requirements and use of standard-compliant materials to prevent future faults, with a warranty on installation and maintenance work.

a2.name: Khaled Nasser
a2.desc: Carpenter and interior decorator with long experience restoring offices and meeting halls. I work with a complete team and offer a one-year warranty on all work after delivery.

a3.name: Yousef Hamdan
a3.desc: Specialized in painting, decoration and interior finishing. Punctual, using high-quality materials at fair prices.

tenderDetails.descTitle: Project description and scope of work
tenderDetails.genericDesc: {{title}} in {{area}}. The full scope of work will appear once the tender data is available from the server.

desc: The project covers a full rehabilitation and restoration of the exterior facades of a 4-storey commercial and residential building on Al-Qassam Street in Nuseirat. It aims to treat structural and surface cracks, clean the exterior stone with pressure washing and suitable materials, and renew the weather-resistant plaster and paint layers.

The work also includes modern water and thermal insulation for balconies and cornices, rewiring the exterior electrical cables, and installing an architectural LED lighting system to highlight the building's appearance according to the attached technical drawings.
